result.summary: Introduces `node::BlockTemplateManager` to consolidate block template creation, block submission, tip-wait helpers, and init-time mining options into a single component. Bypasses the IPC `interfaces::Mining` layer for internal node calls, tests, and RPCs, switching callers directly to the manager. Optimizes `getblocktemplate` to copy only block headers and reference transactions directly, and adds a dedicated fuzz test target.
result.problem: Block template construction, init-time options, and tip-wait coordination were fragmented across `NodeContext`, `miner.cpp`, RPC call sites, and the external `interfaces::Mining` interface. Routing internal RPC and test callers through the IPC interface resulted in redundant block copies and retained `NodeContext` references across template lifetimes.
evidence: PR description: 'Instead of keeping template-related state and helper functions spread across NodeContext, miner.cpp, the mining interface, RPC, and tests, the manager now owns the node's init-time mining options and exposes methods needed by callers.'
PR description: 'This also prevents some redundant copies previously done when using the mining interface to create a block template and then retrieve the template data.'
Commit 38556f817e: 'The block copy exists solely to apply header adjustments... Now that the transactions are read directly from the template, copy only the header instead of the entire block.'
result.scope_notes: Refactors mining template orchestration across `src/init.cpp`, RPC handlers (`blockchain.cpp`, `mining.cpp`), tests, and fuzzing harnesses; excludes `generateblock` and tip-wait RPCs from general RPC fuzzing as they now execute against live state rather than failing on a missing `Mining` interface.
result.card: Introduces node::BlockTemplateManager to centralize block template generation, submission, tip-waiting helpers, and default mining options. It decouples in-process RPCs and tests from the IPC Mining interface, allowing getblocktemplate to avoid copying entire blocks by referencing template transactions directly. The change eliminates scattered mining state across NodeContext and miner.cpp, adds fuzz coverage for template creation, and unblocks template memory and fee tracking in #33922 and #35581.
